title: ZIA device inventory: Client Connector devices and the predefined OS-type device groups

prose.label: What the pages leave open.
prose.text: Whether groups other than the predefined ones can be created is open {{gap:group-creation}}. Which OS types make up the predefined groups is open {{gap:predefined-os-types}}. How the choices that rule pages show in the Device Groups criterion relate to these groups is open {{gap:criterion-choices}}. What the VDI Devices and VDI Device Groups pages hold is open {{gap:vdi-pages}}.

The rules that select device groups are in [[zia.ssl-inspection.criteria]], [[zia.cloud-app-control.rule-criteria]], [[zia.traffic-capture]] and [[zia.iot.policy-use]]; the per-rule caps are in [[zia.firewall.limits]]; the API coverage is in [[zia.api.sdk-coverage]].

devices-page-scope.statement: The Device Management page displays all the devices in the organization that have Zscaler Client Connector deployed, and devices can be selected when configuring policies, to identify Client Connector-managed devices to apply Internet & SaaS security policies.

quotes: The Device Management page displays all the devices in your organization that have the Zscaler Client Connector deployed.
You can select devices when you configure policies
Identify Zscaler Client Connector-managed devices to apply Internet & SaaS security policies.

device-fields.statement: The Devices page shows each device's Device ID, Device Hostname, OS Type, OS Version, Device Model and Device Owner.

quotes: Device ID: The ID of the device.
Device Hostname: The hostname of the device. This field displays values only if you have configured Zscaler Client Connector to collect the hostname information.
OS Type: The OS type of the device.
OS Version: The OS version of the device.
Device Model: The model of the device.
Device Owner: The owner of the device.

hostname-condition.statement: The Device Hostname field displays values only if Zscaler Client Connector has been configured to collect the hostname information.

quotes: Device Hostname: The hostname of the device. This field displays values only if you have configured Zscaler Client Connector to collect the hostname information.

devices-related-pages.statement: The Devices page leads to the Device Groups, VDI Devices and VDI Device Groups pages.

quotes: 6. Go to the Device Groups, VDI Devices, and VDI Device Groups pages.

device-groups-by-os.statement: The Device Groups page displays a list of predefined groups that are defined based on the OS types of the devices in the organization, and the devices that have Zscaler Client Connector deployed are categorized under the respective groups based on their OS type.

quotes: The Device Groups page displays a list of predefined groups. These groups are defined based on the OS types of the devices in your organization.
The devices that have Zscaler Client Connector deployed are categorized under respective groups based on their OS type.

device-groups-purpose.statement: Device groups let an admin organize devices into logical groups to apply Internet & SaaS security policies to many devices at once.

quotes: Organize devices into logical groups to apply Internet & SaaS security policies to many devices at once.

device-group-fields.statement: The Device Groups page shows each group's Group Name and No. of Devices, the number of devices belonging to the group.

quotes: Group Name: The name of the device group.
No. of Devices: The number of devices belonging to the device group.

group-creation.title: Whether device groups other than the predefined OS-type groups can be created
group-creation.detail: The Device Groups page lists predefined groups, while its benefit line gives corporate laptops, mobile devices or IoT devices as examples of logical groups; both SDKs are read-only for device groups (zia.api.sdk-coverage).

predefined-os-types.title: Which OS types make up the predefined device groups
predefined-os-types.detail: The page says the groups are defined on OS types and does not list them.

criterion-choices.title: How the Cloud Browser Isolation, No Client Connector and IoT choices in rule Device Groups criteria relate to the predefined groups
criterion-choices.detail: Rule pages show choices such as OS Type, No Client Connector and Cloud Browser isolation in the Device Groups criterion; the Device Groups page does not list them among the predefined groups.

vdi-pages.title: What the VDI Devices and VDI Device Groups pages hold
vdi-pages.detail: The Devices page links to the VDI Devices and VDI Device Groups pages, which were not captured in this area.
